final_sql: SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School' ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT T2.District
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT T2.CharterNum, T1.sname, T1.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC;
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.School HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey'
  AND T1."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND T1."School Type" = 'High Schools'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1."Enrollment (K-12)" - T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(T3."Enrollment (K-12)" - T3."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM frpm AS T3
    JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
    WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT CAST(T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 ORDER BY T1."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.City = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.School FROM schools AS T2 JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.MailStreet, T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
  AND T1.MailCity = 'Lakeport'
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND City = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.Charter = 0 AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus' AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(GSserved) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT City, GSoffered, School FROM schools WHERE State = 'CA' ORDER BY Latitude ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)`, T2.`District Code` FROM schools AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54;
SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Views DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT posts.Title
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie');

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT posts.Body
FROM tags
JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id
WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011';
SELECT AVG(p.Score) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = 1910);

SELECT c.Text
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM comments
JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE comments.Text = 'thank you user93!'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data';
SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Location LIKE '%New York%' AND Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Teacher') AND Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Supporter');

SELECT T1.UserId
FROM postHistory AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY T1.UserId
HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT T1.PostId)

SELECT b.UserId, b.Name
FROM badges b
WHERE b.UserId = (
    SELECT UserId
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
    ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId) FROM comments c WHERE c.PostId = 3720) AS UniqueCommenters
FROM postHistory ph
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720;

SELECT posts.Score, postLinks.LinkTypeId
FROM posts
JOIN postLinks ON posts.Id = postLinks.PostId
WHERE posts.Id = 395;

SELECT SUM(T1.UpVotes) / COUNT(T1.Id) AS avg_upvotes,
       SUM(T1.Age) / COUNT(T1.Id) AS avg_age
FROM users AS T1
JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
GROUP BY T1.Id
HAVING COUNT(T2.Id) > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Announcer';

SELECT badges.Date
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Rochester, NY';
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Name = 'Teacher' THEN UserId END) / COUNT(UserId) FROM badges;
SELECT T2.Text FROM posts AS T1 JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0'

SELECT DISTINCT users.Age
FROM users
JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';
SELECT badges.Name FROM badges JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Sharpie';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010';
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN Id END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN Id END) FROM votes;

SELECT DISTINCT posts.Tags
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'John Salvatier';

SELECT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY users.DisplayName
ORDER BY SUM(posts.ViewCount) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Commentator' AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '2014';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate BETWEEN '2010-07-21 00:00:00' AND '2012-07-21 23:59:59';
SELECT DisplayName, Age FROM users WHERE Views = (SELECT MAX(Views) FROM users);
SELECT LastEditDate, LastEditorUserId FROM posts WHERE Title = 'Detecting a given face in a database of facial images';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location = 'North Pole'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName, u.WebsiteUrl
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.FavoriteCount > 150;

SELECT COUNT(postHistory.Id) AS PostHistoryCount, posts.LastEditDate
FROM posts
LEFT JOIN postHistory ON posts.Id = postHistory.PostId
WHERE posts.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'
GROUP BY posts.Id, posts.LastEditDate;

SELECT users.LastAccessDate, users.Location
FROM users
JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE badges.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT posts.Id, badges.Name
FROM comments
JOIN posts ON comments.PostId = posts.Id
JOIN badges ON badges.UserId = comments.UserId
WHERE comments.UserDisplayName = 'Samuel'
  AND strftime('%Y', posts.CreaionDate) = '2013'
  AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2013';
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM tags WHERE Count BETWEEN 5000 AND 7000
SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts WHERE FavoriteCount = (SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount) FROM posts);
SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Age = (SELECT MIN(Age) FROM users);

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Name) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS first_vote_date
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl';
SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Reputation DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens' AND strftime('%Y', posts.CreaionDate) = '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ViewCount > 20000
  AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > (SELECT AVG(ViewCount) FROM posts);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ViewCount > 35000 AND CommentCount = 0;

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Emmett'
ORDER BY b.Date DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65 AND UpVotes > 5000;

SELECT julianday(badges.Date) - julianday(users.CreationDate)
FROM users
JOIN badges ON users.Id = badges.UserId
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Zolomon';

SELECT c.Text, u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
LEFT JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT Count FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'careers';
SELECT Reputation, Views FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Jarrod Dixon'

WITH stats_posts AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Score
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(Id) AS percentage
FROM stats_posts;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE Id < 15 AND Count <= 20;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%linear regression%';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id WHERE comments.Score = 0 AND users.Age = 40

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE c.Score BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  AND u.DownVotes = 0;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN users.UpVotes = 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(comments.UserId) AS percentage
FROM comments
JOIN users ON comments.UserId = users.Id
WHERE comments.Score BETWEEN 5 AND 10;

SELECT yearmonth.CustomerID FROM yearmonth JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID WHERE customers.Segment = 'LAM' AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212 ORDER BY yearmonth.Consumption ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212 AND T2.Consumption < 30000

SELECT c.Segment
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM yearmonth AS y
INNER JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312;

SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND T2.Date = '201310' ORDER BY T2.Consumption DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(yearmonth.Consumption) FROM yearmonth JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID WHERE customers.Segment = 'KAM' AND yearmonth.Date = '201305'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN yearmonth.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS Percentage
FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Segment = 'LAM';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM'
SELECT MAX(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012';

SELECT MAX(T.monthly_consumption) FROM (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY y.CustomerID) T

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Description
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN products AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 6) = '201309';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Country FROM gasstations AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Date LIKE '201306%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID)
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000;
SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Amount * Price) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25' ORDER BY T1.Time LIMIT 1

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00'

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201306' AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT T2.Currency
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Price = 548.4 AND T1.Date = '2012-08-24';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
FROM transactions_1k t 
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID 
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT (SELECT SUM(Price) FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = '38508') AS TotalAmountSpent,
       (SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = '38508' AND Date = '201201') AS AmountSpentJanuary2012;

SELECT c.CustomerID,
       SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS AvgPricePerItem,
       c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.home_team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND (M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal) < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
  AND overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010');
SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(pa.long_shots) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_fifa_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) FROM Team_Attributes)
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT PA.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND PA.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND Match.season = '2015/2016';
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY birthday DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';
SELECT AVG(Match.home_team_goal) FROM Match JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Poland' AND Match.season = '2010/2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1990';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', PA.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player_Attributes.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT DISTINCT T.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T
JOIN Team AS C ON T.team_api_id = C.team_api_id
WHERE C.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE L.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' AND strftime('%Y-%m', M.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
ORDER BY pa.crossing DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(Match.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(Player_Attributes.overall_rating) / COUNT(Player_Attributes.id) FROM Player_Attributes INNER JOIN Player ON Player_Attributes.player_api_id = Player.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', Player.birthday) < '1986'

SELECT DISTINCT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p

JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND s.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE r.race <> 'Human' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id JOIN attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id WHERE attribute_name = 'Speed' AND attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';
SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40;
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200);

SELECT T1.Date, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC, T1.Date DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GPT = '9' AND Date = '1992-06-12');

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`)
                      FROM Examination
                      WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND ANA = 'S') * 1.2
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT julianday(T1.`Examination Date`) - julianday(T2.`First Date`)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ID = 821298
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';
SELECT L.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC

SELECT P.ID, L.ALB, CASE WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Normal_Albumin
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT ID, UA, MAX(Date) AS Date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) AS T
JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT sex, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "T-BIL" >= 2.0) GROUP BY sex;

SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T3.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) FROM Examination AS E JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT E.ID
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) < '2000';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN T1.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;
SELECT Birthday FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60) ORDER BY Birthday DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.CRE < 1.5 GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY MAX(T2.`aCL IgA`) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(molecule_id) * 100, 3) AS percent FROM molecule;
SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT label = '+' 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = ' 
    GROUP BY molecule_id 
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb' UNION SELECT c.atom_id FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE a.element = 'pb'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM connected c2
        JOIN atom a3 ON c2.atom_id = a3.atom_id
        JOIN atom a4 ON c2.atom_id2 = a4.atom_id
        GROUP BY a3.element, a4.element
    )
);

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-');
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT T1.bond_id, CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' 
GROUP BY atom.element;
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'ca')
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';
SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bonds, m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT T2.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.bond_type)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T2.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT molecule.label FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND m.molecule_id IN (
      SELECT a.molecule_id
      FROM atom a
      WHERE a.element = 'c'
  );
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR000_4' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2');
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.molecule_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.molecule_id) AS cnt
        FROM molecule AS m2
        JOIN atom AS a2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    )
);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' AND T1.label = '-'

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education' ORDER BY `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT schools.Phone FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT s.District FROM schools s JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY s.District ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda' AND schools.StatusType = 'Merged' AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT T1.sname, T2.CharterNum
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
seg_mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avgs AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN seg_mins sm ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)

  -

   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

                             AND T3.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T3.Currency = 'CZK'))
  AS DIFFERENCE_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment AS Segment, SUM(z.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

   FROM customers AS T1

                           FROM customers AS T3
                           JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T3.Currency = 'CZK' AND T3.Segment = 'SME'
                             AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                           FROM customers AS T3
                           JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T3.Currency = 'CZK' AND T3.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS "SME - LAM",
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                           FROM customers AS T3
                           JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T3.Currency = 'CZK' AND T3.Segment = 'LAM'
                             AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                           FROM customers AS T3
                           JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T3.Currency = 'CZK' AND T3.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  AS "LAM - KAM",
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
     AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                           FROM customers AS T3
                           JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                           WHERE T3.Currency = 'CZK' AND T3.Segment = 'KAM'
                             AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T2.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'SME'

JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
GROUP BY T1.id
HAVING COUNT(T1.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY height_cm DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage,
       SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND T2.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T3.colour
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm = 185 AND T2.race = 'Human'

SELECT T1.power_name
FROM superpower AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
WHERE T2.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler');
SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS T1
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero
);

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) > COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END),
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date, strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM` 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.`Description` = '1994-02-19' 
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4' AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+'
GROUP BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination)
                    + (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 0.2

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' 
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY((SELECT MIN("Examination Date") FROM Examination WHERE ID = 821298))
     - JULIANDAY((SELECT "First Date" FROM Patient WHERE ID = 821298)) AS days;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT P.ID, L.ALP,
       CASE WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Normal_Range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday LIKE '1982-04-01%';

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;
SELECT * FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB <= 3.5 OR ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(T3.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID)
  AND ((T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;
SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T2.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT L."ID", L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L."ID" = P."ID"
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."U-PRO" > 0
  AND Laboratory."U-PRO" < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.IGG > 900 AND T1.IGG < 2000 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) < '2000';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE "aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination) AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE < 1.5)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND T3."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(bond.bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'c') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type
LIMIT 2;

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(T1.bond_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE m.label
           WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) AS tally
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;
SELECT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT count(*) 
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T4.bond_type) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T2.bond_id = T4.bond_id 
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id 
WHERE T3.label = 'TR346' 
GROUP BY T1.atom_id

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's')
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';
SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2' INTERSECT SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label = '+' FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS cnt
        FROM molecule
        JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
        WHERE molecule.label = '+'
        GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
    )
);

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segavg AS (
    SELECT f.Segment, SUM(f.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk2013 f
    JOIN mincons m
      ON m.Segment = f.Segment AND m.min_consumption = f.Consumption
    GROUP BY f.Segment
)
SELECT (SELECT annual_avg FROM segavg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
         - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segavg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
       (SELECT annual_avg FROM segavg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
         - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segavg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  AS difference_SME_LAM,

  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  AS difference_LAM_KAM,

  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
     AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID)
   FROM yearmonth y
   JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND c.Currency = 'CZK'

  AS difference_KAM_SME;

JOIN (
    SELECT M.country_id AS country_id, P.weight AS weight
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Player P
      ON P.player_api_id IN (
          M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
          M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10,
          M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4,
          M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9,
          M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11

) T ON C.id = T.country_id

WITH italy_matches AS (
    SELECT m.*
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate

JOIN disp AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) IN ('96', '97');

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption,
           MIN(ym.Consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY c.Segment) AS min_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013
    WHERE Consumption = min_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient

WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS 'Albumin Within Normal Range'
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982'

SELECT AVG(T3.UA)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID AND T3.Date = T2.LatestDate
WHERE (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T3.UA < 8.0)
   OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.UA < 6.5)

SELECT CAST(COUNT(bond.bond_type) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS average_single_bonds

JOIN molecule  ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

);

       SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'KAM' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN c.Segment = 'SME' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM customers AS c
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312;

SELECT

    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    THEN 'More in-patients' 
    ELSE 'More outpatients' 
  END AS comparison,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
