WITH CustomerConsumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer, along with their segment
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        y.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
SegmentAvg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest consumers / their count
    SELECT
        cc.Segment,
        SUM(cc.TotalConsumption) / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM CustomerConsumption cc
    JOIN MinPerSegment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment
     AND cc.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_Diff,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_Diff,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM SegmentAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_Diff;

WITH oldest_female AS (
    -- Female clients who are oldest (later birth_date => older)
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date)
                        FROM client
                        WHERE gender = 'F')
),
oldest_female_salary AS (
    -- Average salary (A11) of those oldest female clients' districts
    SELECT o.client_id, d.A11
    FROM oldest_female o
    JOIN district d ON o.district_id = d.district_id
),
lowest_salary AS (
    -- The lowest average salary among the oldest female clients
    SELECT MIN(A11) AS min_sal
    FROM oldest_female_salary
),
highest_salary AS (
    -- The highest average salary overall
    SELECT MAX(A11) AS max_sal
    FROM district
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT max_sal FROM highest_salary) -
       (SELECT min_sal FROM lowest_salary) AS gap
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN oldest_female_salary ofs ON c.client_id = ofs.client_id
WHERE ofs.A11 = (SELECT min_sal FROM lowest_salary);

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp   d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') 
    - 
    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS debt_amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan not paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running contract - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running contract - client in debt'
    END AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT
    -- Count of male in-patients
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_inpatients,
    -- Count of male outpatients
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_outpatients,
    -- Which group is larger
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
             > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'In-patients'
        ELSE 'Outpatients'
    END AS more_common,
    -- Deviation in percentage: in-patients / outpatients
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
              SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        4
    ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT JULIANDAY(T2.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982/04/01';

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS Albumin_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory L2
    WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
)
AND (
    (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
    OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS is_more_male
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.ID IN (
    SELECT Laboratory.ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
);

SELECT
    Patient.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.[U-PRO] > 0
  AND T2.[U-PRO] < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.ID IN (
        SELECT Laboratory.ID
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
      )
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.KCT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T3.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND E.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
  ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.DNA < 8
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1.ID = (
    SELECT T2.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T2
    WHERE T2.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY E.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND T2."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom      ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'not carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b 
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' 
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    printf('%.5f',
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(b.bond_id)
    ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) 
FROM atom 
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id 
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) = 2 THEN 'YES' 
    ELSE 'NO' 
END
FROM connected AS T3
JOIN atom AS T1 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND T1.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+'
  AND substr(T1.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
       m.label          AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type   = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c 
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
          SELECT molecule_id
          FROM atom
          WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
          SELECT molecule_id
          FROM bond
          WHERE bond_type = '='
      );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'cl' AND T2.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
  AND T2.element = 'c';

SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
INTERSECT
SELECT molecule_id
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c 
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b 
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' 
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND (a1.element = 'o' OR a2.element = 'o');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s
     ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(sc.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores AS sc
JOIN schools AS s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr < 100
  AND T2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged';

SELECT 
    T2.sname,
    T2.AvgScrWrite,
    T1.CharterNum
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T1.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T2.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School,
       s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t
     ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(t.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`School Type` = 'High Schools'
  AND f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM frpm f2
        JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
      );

SELECT
    `School Name`,
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey'
  AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'
  AND T2.County = 'Fresno';

SELECT 
    s.AvgScrWrite, 
    sc.City
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.MailStreet AS postal_street,
    s.School AS school_name
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat 
    ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
  AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson'
  AND AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1
  AND County = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND (f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' 
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 
        AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND `Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND `High Grade` = '9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.City,
    f.`Low Grade`,
    s.School
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    s.City,
    COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS NumOfSchools
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s.City;

SELECT 
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
    f.`District Code`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'

  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t 
    ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT a.date AS account_opened_date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840
  AND t.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(trans.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM trans
JOIN disp  ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card  ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND account.date LIKE '1996%';

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l    ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')          -- 'C' = running contract, 'D' = running contract, client in debt
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.A3 AS branch_location, 
       d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
WHERE d.A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(A16 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loan_count
FROM loan l
JOIN account a 
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS running_contract_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(*) AS pct_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE d.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3 AS region
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_women
FROM disp dp
JOIN client c   ON c.client_id   = dp.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    100.0 * (
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
        -
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    )
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp   AS d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) 
    - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district
WHERE A3 IN ('north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia');

SELECT strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.account_id = 130
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount                              AS total_loan_amount,
    l.payments                            AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration                            AS duration_months,
    l.status,
    COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)            AS paid_so_far,
    l.amount - COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp d  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan l  ON l.account_id = d.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans t
       ON t.account_id = l.account_id
      AND t.k_symbol   = 'SPLATKA'        -- loan instalment payments
      AND t.date       >= l.date          -- only payments made after the loan was issued
WHERE c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY
    c.client_id, l.loan_id, l.amount, l.payments, l.duration, l.status;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loan_accounts

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT DISTINCT m.email

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count

INNER JOIN budget b  ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name

SELECT

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes

SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id) AS bad_percentage,

SELECT c.colour

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race

SELECT T1.height_cm

SELECT s.full_name

SELECT publisher.publisher_name

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        2
    ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
    AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(T2.Birthday, 1, 4) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.ANA = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET DISEASE'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - above normal range'
    END AS ALP_normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT P.ID,
       L.TP,
       L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L
     ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.ID = p.ID
      )
  AND (
        (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
        OR
        (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT (SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F')) AS answer
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_list
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l.`T-CHO` AS T_CHO_index
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` >= 30
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900
  AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND L.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l 
    ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.DNA < 8
  AND T2.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN L.GOT >= 60 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN L.ID END) * 1.0
       / COUNT(CASE WHEN L.GOT >= 60 THEN L.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(E.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination E
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
GROUP BY E.ID
ORDER BY MAX(E.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_chlorine
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'      -- single bond
  AND m.label = '-'          -- not carcinogenic
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id 
    FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 
    FROM connected
);

SELECT a1.element AS atom1_element, 
       a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt), 2) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element AS element1,
           a2.element AS element2,
           COUNT(*)   AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t;

SELECT ROUND(
           SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
           / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
           5
       ) AS carcinogenic_proportion_pct
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) AS num_elements
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS has_both_cl_and_c
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND (
        (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')   -- chlorine on one end, carbon on the other
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl')  -- carbon on one end, chlorine on the other
      );

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS num_non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds,
    m.label
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
       ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
      AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'          -- molecules that contain sulphur → exclude
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '='        -- molecules that have a double bond → exclude
      );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' 
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
JOIN atom a2 ON m.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(num_atoms)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom_id) AS num_atoms
        FROM atom
        WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id
                              FROM molecule
                              WHERE label = '+')
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_with_triple_bonds
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT T1.sname, T2.CharterNum, T1.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL AND T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.Zip, T2.State FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Monterey' AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools'

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.School FROM schools AS s JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.DOC = '31' ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.sname, T2.MailStreet FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport' AND satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson' UNION SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez'
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.School, T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND T1.`High Grade` = '9' AND T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.City, f.`Low Grade`, s.School FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.State = 'CA' ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*), T2.City, count(*) FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' AND T2.Magnet = 1 AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8' GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT T2."District Code", T2."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / T2."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" FROM schools AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3 FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND City = 'San Bernardino' AND DOC = 54 AND SOC = 62 AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'
SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Views DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT p.Title FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;
SELECT posts.Body FROM tags JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges b JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';
SELECT AVG(p.Score) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT COUNT(c.Id) FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910

SELECT c.Text
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829 AND p.CommentCount = 1;
SELECT UserDisplayName FROM comments WHERE Text = 'thank you user93!';
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data';
SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id

SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" >= 30

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) > 60
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')
SELECT DISTINCT T2.element FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2

SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt

    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id;
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AND bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id FROM atom AS T3 JOIN connected AS T1 ON T3.atom_id = T1.atom_id JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS REAL) / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) FROM atom a JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY atom.element
SELECT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(bond_type = ' = ') * 1.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl'
SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = 'TR346' GROUP BY a.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a JOIN atom b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND b.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 's' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '+' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" != 0 AND CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE SOCType LIKE '%Continuation%') ORDER BY "Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT s.Phone FROM satscores st JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2."Enrollment (K-12)" + T2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT s.District
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(t.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.County = 'Alameda'
  AND schools.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND satscores.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT satscores.sname, schools.CharterNum, satscores.AvgScrWrite FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(t.AvgScrMath) > 400
SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800 AND s.County = 'Monterey' AND s.GSserved = '9-12'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )
SELECT f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode" ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s1.School
FROM schools AS s1
JOIN frpm AS f1 ON s1.CDSCode = f1.CDSCode
JOIN schools AS s2 ON s2.DOC = '31'
JOIN frpm AS f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
WHERE s1.DOC = '31'
GROUP BY s1.CDSCode, s1.School, f1."Enrollment (K-12)"
HAVING f1."Enrollment (K-12)" >= MAX(f2."Enrollment (K-12)")

SELECT s.MailStreet, s.School
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sc.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
  AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Charter = 0 AND T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT schools.CDSCode) FROM schools JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Hickman' AND schools.CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND schools.County = 'Stanislaus' AND schools.OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'

SELECT schools.County FROM schools WHERE schools.SOC = 11 AND CAST(substr(schools.ClosedDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 GROUP BY schools.County ORDER BY COUNT(schools.CDSCode) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School, f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND f."Low Grade" = 'K' AND f."High Grade" = '9'

SELECT s.City, f."Low Grade", s.School FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.State = 'CA' ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC LIMIT 1

FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

WITH seg_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM seg_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT s.Segment, SUM(s.TotalConsumption) AS TotalCons, COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers
    FROM seg_totals s
    JOIN min_per_seg m ON s.Segment = m.Segment AND s.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY s.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalCons * 1.0 / NumCustomers AS AnnualAvg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT
  SME - LAM AS SME_LAM,
  LAM - KAM AS LAM_KAM,
  KAM - SME AS KAM_SME
FROM (
  SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
       FROM yearmonth y
      WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND y.CustomerID IN (SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'SME')
        AND y.CustomerID IN (SELECT y2.CustomerID
                               FROM yearmonth y2
                              WHERE y2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
                                AND y2.CustomerID IN (SELECT c2.CustomerID FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK' AND c2.Segment = 'SME')
                              GROUP BY y2.CustomerID
                              HAVING SUM(y2.Consumption) = (SELECT MIN(t.Total)
                                                              FROM (SELECT SUM(y3.Consumption) AS Total
                                                                      FROM yearmonth y3
                                                                     WHERE y3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
                                                                       AND y3.CustomerID IN (SELECT c3.CustomerID FROM customers c3 WHERE c3.Currency = 'CZK' AND c3.Segment = 'SME')
                                                                     GROUP BY y3.CustomerID) t))) AS SME,
    (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
       FROM yearmonth y
      WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND y.CustomerID IN (SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'LAM')
        AND y.CustomerID IN (SELECT y2.CustomerID
                               FROM yearmonth y2
                              WHERE y2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
                                AND y2.CustomerID IN (SELECT c2.CustomerID FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK' AND c2.Segment = 'LAM')
                              GROUP BY y2.CustomerID
                              HAVING SUM(y2.Consumption) = (SELECT MIN(t.Total)
                                                              FROM (SELECT SUM(y3.Consumption) AS Total
                                                                      FROM yearmonth y3
                                                                     WHERE y3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
                                                                       AND y3.CustomerID IN (SELECT c3.CustomerID FROM customers c3 WHERE c3.Currency = 'CZK' AND c3.Segment = 'LAM')
                                                                     GROUP BY y3.CustomerID) t))) AS LAM,
    (SELECT SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID)
       FROM yearmonth y
      WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
        AND y.CustomerID IN (SELECT c.CustomerID FROM customers c WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment = 'KAM')
        AND y.CustomerID IN (SELECT y2.CustomerID
                               FROM yearmonth y2
                              WHERE y2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
                                AND y2.CustomerID IN (SELECT c2.CustomerID FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK' AND c2.Segment = 'KAM')
                              GROUP BY y2.CustomerID
                              HAVING SUM(y2.Consumption) = (SELECT MIN(t.Total)
                                                              FROM (SELECT SUM(y3.Consumption) AS Total
                                                                      FROM yearmonth y3
                                                                     WHERE y3.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
                                                                       AND y3.CustomerID IN (SELECT c3.CustomerID FROM customers c3 WHERE c3.Currency = 'CZK' AND c3.Segment = 'KAM')
                                                                     GROUP BY y3.CustomerID) t))) AS KAM
) diffs;

WITH bond_elem AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS e2
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
combo AS (
    SELECT e1, e2, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elem
    GROUP BY e1, e2
),
mx AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt
    FROM combo
),
tot AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_bonds
    FROM bond
)
SELECT 100.0 * mx.max_cnt / tot.total_bonds AS percentage
FROM mx
CROSS JOIN tot;

WITH cons AS (SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 AND c.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment), mins AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS m FROM cons GROUP BY Segment), lowest AS (SELECT cons.Segment, SUM(cons.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg FROM cons JOIN mins ON cons.Segment = mins.Segment AND cons.total = mins.m GROUP BY cons.Segment) SELECT (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM, (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME

),
p AS (
  SELECT home_player_1 AS player_id FROM m

  UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM m
  UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM m
  UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM m

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_totals AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_totals WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment, SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM customer_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals m ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_cons) AS sum_cons, COUNT(*) AS num_cust
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_cons * 1.0 / num_cust AS avg_cons
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND T2.Consumption > 1000

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date, t.Time
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T2.Country FROM gasstations AS T2 JOIN transactions_1k AS T1 ON T2.GasStationID = T1.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00'

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date LIKE '%201306%' AND y.Consumption = 214582.17;

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
) t
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID;

SELECT SUM(Amount * Price) AS total_spent,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Date = '201201' THEN Amount * Price ELSE 0 END) AS spent_january_2012
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508;

SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item, c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
ORDER BY SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);
SELECT player_name, height FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);
SELECT T1.preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 WHERE T1.potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        AND overall_rating > (
            SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
            FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
        )
  );
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(pa.long_shots) / COUNT(pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name, SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY average_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';
SELECT PA.heading_accuracy FROM Player_Attributes AS PA JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name = 'Francois Affolter' AND PA.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND Match.season = '2015/2016'

SELECT T1.preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

LIMIT 1;
SELECT League.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT AVG(Match.home_team_goal) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match
JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Poland'
  AND Match.season = '2010/2011';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1990';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.overall_rating > 80
AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010'

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_fifa_api_id = T.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;
SELECT c.name FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE l.name = 'Italy Serie A';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id WHERE L.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga' AND strftime('%Y-%m', M.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.overall_rating) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(m.id)
FROM Match AS m
INNER JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
