SELECT L.name FROM League AS L JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id WHERE M.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY L.name ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T2.overall_rating) / COUNT(T1.id)
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986';
SELECT pa.preferred_foot FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77
  AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';
SELECT T1.defensive_work_rate FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND T1.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
    M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10,
    M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4,
    M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9,
    M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (
    M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4,
    M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8,
    M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
    M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4,
    M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8,
    M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) mp
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = mp.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT AVG(height) AS average_height
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
);
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT COUNT(account_id)
FROM account
WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A3 = 'Prague')
  AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE status = 'C');

SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) 
FROM client c 
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
  AND d.A11 > 6000 
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T1.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T4.A11 AS gap
FROM account T1
JOIN disp T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN district T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T3.gender = 'F'
  AND T3.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND T4.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(T6.A11)
        FROM client T5
        JOIN district T6 ON T5.district_id = T6.district_id
        WHERE T5.gender = 'F'
          AND T5.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  );

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND T1.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT a.date
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840
  AND t.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'
);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice' AND a.date LIKE '96%';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM card INNER JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id WHERE card.type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_issued_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;
SELECT d.A3 FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.client_id = 3541

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) 
      - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 
      / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';
SELECT (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') - (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

SELECT strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM disp
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE disp.disp_id = 130 AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT l.amount AS debt_amount, l.status AS payment_status, l.payments AS monthly_payment, l.duration
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun' 
  AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.status = 'B' 
  AND loan.duration = 24 
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT T1.client_id,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id
WHERE T3.type = 'gold' AND T2.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.college = 'Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT member.phone
FROM event
JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT event.event_name
FROM event
JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
GROUP BY event.event_id, event.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(attendance.link_to_member) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T3.first_name = 'Sacha' AND T3.last_name = 'Harrison' AND YEAR(T1.event_date) = 2019

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Meeting' 
  AND event_id IN (
      SELECT link_to_event 
      FROM attendance 
      GROUP BY link_to_event 
      HAVING COUNT(link_to_member) > 10
  )

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 20;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.event_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting' AND strftime('%Y', T1.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';
SELECT budget.spent FROM budget JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id WHERE event.event_name = 'September Meeting' AND budget.category = 'Food';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';
SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14';
SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'November Meeting' AND b.remaining < 0;
SELECT SUM(b.amount) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member AS T1 JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.major_name = 'Business' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS minTotal
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avgConsumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minTotals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.minTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avgConsumption FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T1."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX(T3."aCL IgA") FROM Examination AS T3 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5)

SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN atom ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';
SELECT SUM(element = 'c') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT DISTINCT t1.atom_id, t2.atom_id
FROM connected AS t1
JOIN connected AS t2 ON t1.bond_id = t2.bond_id AND t1.atom_id = t2.atom_id2 AND t1.atom_id2 = t2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS t3 ON t1.bond_id = t3.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS t4 ON t3.molecule_id = t4.molecule_id
WHERE t4.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id ASC LIMIT 2;
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT m.label FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic;
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT c.atom_id2

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected
    JOIN atom a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.element) FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT element) = 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM (
  SELECT T1.element FROM connected AS T2 JOIN atom AS T1 ON T2.atom_id = T1.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT bond.bond_id, CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
SELECT element, COUNT(*) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY element

SELECT CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'ca'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT connected.bond_id) FROM connected JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl'

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(b.bond_type)

JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

GROUP BY a.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule

    - SUM(CASE WHEN customers.Segment = 'LAM' THEN yearmonth.Consumption ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN customers.Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(d.A12) > AVG(d.A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district d;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND LOWER(d.A3) = 'north bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM account
WHERE account_id IN (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id IN (
        SELECT client_id
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
          AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district ORDER BY A11 ASC LIMIT 1)
        ORDER BY birth_date ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
)

JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND trans.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha' AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.type = 'gold' AND c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card c;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', loan.date) AS INTEGER) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN d.A16 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN d.A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN d.A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district d
WHERE d.A3 IN ('north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia');

SELECT strftime('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)

SELECT loan.amount AS debt_amount, loan.payments AS monthly_payment, loan.status AS payment_status

JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT Patient.ID,
       CASE
           WHEN Laboratory.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Not within normal range'
       END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS L1
JOIN Patient AS P ON L1.ID = P.ID
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS L2 ON L2.ID = L1.ID AND L2.Date > L1.Date
WHERE L2.ID IS NULL
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L1.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L1.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT Patient.ID, MAX(Laboratory.`T-CHO`) AS `T-CHO`
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
GROUP BY Patient.ID
ORDER BY MAX(Laboratory.`T-CHO`) DESC, MIN(Patient.Birthday) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.APTT > 45 AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01' 
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."U-PRO" > 0 AND L."U-PRO" < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000 AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE >= 1.5) AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND Examination.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Date
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ALB > 3.5 AND T1.ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY T1.ALB DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.ALB > 3.5
  AND l.ALB < 5.5
  AND l.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3."aCL IgA" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND Examination."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
GROUP BY b.bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(bond.bond_type = '-') * 1.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '=';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY atom.element ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2

SELECT bond.bond_type, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
ORDER BY COUNT(bond.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c1 ON a.atom_id = c1.atom_id
LEFT JOIN connected c2 ON a.atom_id = c2.atom_id2
WHERE c1.atom_id IS NULL AND c2.atom_id2 IS NULL;

SELECT T3.element, T4.element
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T4 ON T2.atom_id2 = T4.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS T5 ON T1.molecule_id = T5.molecule_id
WHERE T5.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND T1.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS percentage
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT SUM(b.bond_type = ' = ') * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1'

SELECT DISTINCT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count,
       label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT T3.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element != 's' AND bond.bond_type != ' = ';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT m.label FROM molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.label
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = ' = ' AND T3.element = 's';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id AND b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' AND T1.label = '-'

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT schools.Phone FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT schools.District FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY schools.District ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores T1 JOIN schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100
SELECT T2.CharterNum FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM schools AS T2 JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.School HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm AS f JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey' AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1."Enrollment (K-12)" - T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > (
    SELECT AVG(T3."Enrollment (K-12)" - T3."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM frpm AS T3
    INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
    WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" FROM frpm ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT T2."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / T2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM schools AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson') OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson') OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson')
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 ORDER BY T1."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.School, T2.MailStreet FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite >= 1500 AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Charter = 0 AND T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / T1."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.School, T1."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / T1."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1."County Name" = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.GSserved = 'K-9'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(GSserved) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.City, T1.`Low Grade`, T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY T2.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T2.City), T2.City FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 AND T1.`Low Grade` = 'K' AND T1.`High Grade` = '8' AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT frpm."District Code", frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine' OR schools.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine' OR schools.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND date(OpenDate) BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Views DESC LIMIT 1

FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';
SELECT AnswerCount FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie') ORDER BY AnswerCount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT users.DisplayName FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id WHERE posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
SELECT posts.Body FROM tags JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011'
SELECT AVG(p.Score) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId = (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = 1910)

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments AS c
JOIN posts AS p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829 AND p.CommentCount = 1;
SELECT DisplayName FROM users JOIN comments ON users.Id = comments.UserId WHERE comments.Text = 'thank you user93!'
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data'
SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id

  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'

WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%' 
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Teacher') 
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Supporter');

SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'LAM'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'KAM'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -
  (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
   FROM customers AS T1
   INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
   WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T1.Segment = 'SME'
     AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)

WITH y2013 AS (                        -- total 2013 consumption per customer
    SELECT CustomerID,
           SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
ranked AS (                            -- rank customers within each segment
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           y.total_consumption,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.Segment
                        ORDER BY y.total_consumption) AS rnk
    FROM y2013 y
    JOIN customer c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
),
annual_avg AS (                        -- average consumption of the "lowest" customer(s)
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rnk = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT

WITH per_customer AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption for each CZK customer in each segment
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        y.CustID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customer AS c
        ON y.CustID = c.CustID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'   -- 2013 → BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_2013) AS min_total
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_avg AS (
    -- Annual average of lowest-consuming customer(s) = sum of their totals / their count
    SELECT
        p.Segment,
        SUM(p.total_2013) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_lowest
    FROM per_customer AS p
    JOIN min_per_segment AS m
        ON p.Segment = m.Segment
       AND p.total_2013 = m.min_total
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg_lowest FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_lowest FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_lowest FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_lowest FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_lowest FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_lowest FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_average FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_sme_lam,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_lam_kam,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_average FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_kam_sme

WITH annual AS (                      -- total 2013 consumption per CZK customer
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_2013
    FROM   yearmonth AS y
    JOIN   customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE  y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312     -- year 2013
      AND  c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
minima AS (                           -- lowest annual consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_2013) AS lowest
    FROM   annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
low_cust AS (                         -- annual average of the least-consuming customers per segment
    SELECT a.Segment,
           SUM(a.total_2013) / COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS avg_annual
    FROM   annual AS a
    JOIN   minima AS m
           ON m.Segment = a.Segment AND m.lowest = a.total_2013
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_annual FROM low_cust WHERE Segment = 'SME')
- (SELECT avg_annual FROM low_cust WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,

  (SELECT avg_annual FROM low_cust WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
- (SELECT avg_annual FROM low_cust WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,

  (SELECT avg_annual FROM low_cust WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
- (SELECT avg_annual FROM low_cust WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg

)

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m
  ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
                         m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
                         m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
                         m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
                         m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
                         m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, p.player_api_id, p.weight
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
                             m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
                             m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
                             m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
) t ON t.country_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(t.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM account a
JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (
      SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
      FROM client c2
      JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
      WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
        AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  );

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) 
     - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) 
     * 100.0 
     / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate

JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

WITH seg_cust AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM seg_cust
    GROUP BY Segment
),
least AS (
    SELECT sc.Segment AS Segment, SUM(sc.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AvgCons
    FROM seg_cust AS sc
    JOIN mincons AS mc ON sc.Segment = mc.Segment AND sc.TotalConsumption = mc.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY sc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgCons FROM least WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AvgCons FROM least WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgCons FROM least WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AvgCons FROM least WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgCons FROM least WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AvgCons FROM least WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM czk_2013 t
    JOIN min_seg m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
      (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT y.Segment, AVG(y.TotalConsumption) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN mincons m ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY y.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;
